bim.title: A model is only useful when it is checked against the real project
bim.description: Uploading an IFC gives you an element count. Comparing it with your tasks, schedule, disciplines and issues tells you whether the model matches the job.
bim.findingStrong: 4 electrical installation tasks exist, but this IFC contains no electrical elements.
bim.findingRest: The uploaded revision exposes none of the characteristic IFC classes for that discipline (IfcCableCarrierSegment, IfcLightFixture, IfcOutlet, IfcSwitchingDevice).
bim.findingMeta: Severity: Critical · Evidence: 4 matched tasks, matched terms “electrical” and “cable” · Suggested action: confirm whether the discipline model was omitted from this export, or whether the wrong model was uploaded.
bim.advisory: Findings are advisory. An engineer decides what happens next.

DISCIPLINE_NOT_IN_IFC.title: {{taskCount}} {{label}} task(s) exist, but the IFC contains no {{discipline}} elements
DISCIPLINE_NOT_IN_IFC.description: Project tasks describe {{label}}, while the active model exposes none of the characteristic IFC classes for that discipline.
DISCIPLINE_NOT_IN_IFC.reason: Task wording was matched against a fixed discipline vocabulary and compared with the IFC entity classes extracted from this revision. Absence of the classes is factual; the intent behind the task wording is not verified.
DISCIPLINE_NOT_IN_IFC.recommendedAction: Confirm whether the discipline model was omitted from this export, or whether the wrong model was uploaded for this project.

TASK_ELEMENTS_MISSING.title: Tasks reference {{category}} work but the IFC contains no matching elements
TASK_ELEMENTS_MISSING.description: {{taskCount}} task(s) reference {{category}} scope; no {{expectedClasses}} elements were extracted.
TASK_ELEMENTS_MISSING.reason: Task terminology was compared with deterministic IFC entity classes.
TASK_ELEMENTS_MISSING.recommendedAction: Verify IFC export scope/classification and confirm that the correct discipline model was uploaded.

IFC_PROJECT_NAME_MISMATCH.title: IFC identity appears inconsistent with this project
IFC_PROJECT_NAME_MISMATCH.description: The IFC project/building/site names have low similarity to the platform project name “{{projectName}}”.
IFC_PROJECT_NAME_MISMATCH.reason: Normalized token overlap and string similarity were below the compatibility threshold.
IFC_PROJECT_NAME_MISMATCH.recommendedAction: Verify that the correct model was uploaded before activation or downstream coordination.
